remarks: Set in one of only two buildings at Rivers Edge that do not face other buildings front and back, this 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers a rare, semi-private patio overlooking the community's landscaped grounds. A private elevator serving all three levels further distinguishes this home on the Stamford/Darien border.  The entry level features a flexible family room with direct access to the garden patio, an upgraded laundry area with new washer/dryer, utility sink, and hose spigot, along with a newer water heater and direct garage entry.  The main level showcases hardwood floors throughout a spacious living room and eat-in kitchen appointed with stainless steel appliances, gas range, and center island. Sliding doors open to a sunny, newly built deck, and a half bath completes the floor.  The top level includes a generous primary suite with walk-in closet, jetted tub, separate shower, and double vanity. The second bedroom also offers a walk-in closet, complemented by a full hall bath and additional storage. A stand-up attic provides substantial storage space.  Thoughtful updates include a full HVAC replacement in August 2024 featuring dual zones, WiFi thermostats, and a 10-year parts warranty. Carpeting was replaced in 2020 and has been professionally cleaned annually. The home is pre-wired for a security system and includes accessibility features throughout.  Residents enjoy a community pool, clubhouse, fitness center, and professionally maintained grounds.
